description: The captured text of a statute, regulation, court rule, or opinion. Document ids come from get_case (capturedSources) or a search_library source hit. It does not have to arrive whole: outline lists the sections and their sizes, query returns only the sections matching it, maxChars caps how much text comes back, and offset pages through the rest. Reach for one of those first on an opinion -- a full one runs to tens of thousands of characters.

maxChars.description: Cap the text returned across all sections; the last one is clipped and says so. An excerpt, rather than all-or-nothing.

outline.description: Structure only: every section's index, label, heading, and length, with no text. The cheapest way to find the part worth reading.

query.description: Return only the sections that match these words, most matching first. Use it for "the part about X" instead of reading the whole document.

name: get_source_text
title: Read captured source text
